# Stored-data freeze, part (d) (refactor plan S3, invariant I16, quirk Q17): every table after
# Migrate, the columns that tie its rows to a workspace (org_id, project_id, artifact_id), and how
# PurgeOrg reaches it: "deleted" by a statement, "cascade from" tables that are reached (a NOT NULL
# ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key; a nullable one misses rows whose key is NULL, so it does not count),
# "not reached" (no such column), or GAP: a scoped table a purge leaves rows in, which must be on
# purgeGapAllowlist in migration_freeze_purge_test.go (it may only shrink).
# A line ending in @requires(x) exists only where extension x is installed.
# Regenerate (a behavior change only) with every S3 golden, against a server with the vector and
# pg_trgm extensions:
# UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/persistence/postgres -count=1 -run '^(TestMigrationFreeze|TestEveryBootFreeze|TestSchemaGolden|TestPurgeCatalog)$'
agent_proposals scope project_id cascade from agent_runs,projects
agent_run_logs scope - cascade from agent_runs
agent_runs scope org_id,project_id deleted
agent_team_edges scope - cascade from agent_team_nodes,agent_teams
agent_team_nodes scope - cascade from agent_teams
agent_teams scope org_id,project_id deleted
agents scope org_id deleted
artifact_embeddings scope artifact_id deleted  @requires(vector)
artifact_ref_counters scope project_id deleted
artifacts scope project_id deleted
attachment_figure_counters scope artifact_id deleted
attachment_versions scope - deleted
attachments scope artifact_id deleted
attribute_definitions scope org_id,project_id deleted
automations scope org_id,project_id deleted
baselines scope project_id cascade from projects
boot_tasks scope - not reached
chatter scope artifact_id deleted
connector_pairings scope org_id cascade from organizations
domain_events scope org_id,project_id deleted
email_verifications scope - not reached
evidence_bundles scope project_id cascade from projects
evidence_citations scope - cascade from evidence_bundles,test_results
evidence_files scope - deleted
guided_session_messages scope - cascade from guided_sessions
guided_sessions scope org_id,project_id deleted
hosted_workers scope org_id cascade from organizations
interview_invites scope - cascade from interviews
interview_messages scope - cascade from interview_sessions
interview_sessions scope - cascade from interviews
interviews scope project_id deleted
link_artifacts scope artifact_id deleted
links scope - deleted
notifications scope org_id deleted
org_invitations scope org_id cascade from organizations
org_members scope org_id cascade from organizations
org_team_members scope - cascade from org_teams
org_teams scope org_id cascade from organizations
organizations scope - deleted
password_resets scope - not reached
product_profiles scope project_id cascade from projects
project_members scope project_id cascade from projects
project_share_links scope project_id cascade from projects
project_team_access scope project_id cascade from org_teams,projects
projects scope org_id deleted
provider_logins scope org_id deleted
provider_settings scope org_id deleted
push_subscriptions scope - not reached
release_announcements scope - not reached
release_schedule scope org_id cascade from organizations
repo_connections scope project_id cascade from projects
runner_pool_nodes scope - not reached
runner_sessions scope org_id cascade from organizations
schema_migrations scope - not reached
sessions scope - not reached
shared_product_reports scope - not reached
shared_product_votes scope - not reached
shared_products scope - not reached
templates scope org_id deleted
test_results scope - cascade from test_runs
test_runs scope project_id deleted
user_activity_days scope - not reached
user_repo_paths scope - cascade from repo_connections
users scope - not reached
work_item_activity scope - cascade from work_items
work_items scope project_id deleted
worker_keys scope org_id cascade from organizations
